efeitos.mencoes: Notifies {lista}, if those rovers exist and haven't muted your rover.
efeitos.links: Shows the full address: {lista}. The network never opens the link for you.
efeitos.nenhum: Notifies nobody and creates no tag or link.

notas.recado: The message stays on the recipient's wall until they or you delete it. If the person only takes messages from friends, the relay may refuse it.
notas.depoimento: The testimonial only shows on the profile after its owner accepts. Until then, only they and you can read it.
notas.entrega: This delivery becomes public in the rover's portfolio. The text describes the work in general terms: no files, no client names, nothing private.
notas.comunidade-criar: A public community shows in lists and search. You become its owner and answer for its rules and moderation.
notas.comunidade-criar-fechada: A closed community shows in no list, no search and no profile. To outsiders it doesn't exist. Only invited rovers get in.
notas.comunidade-atualizar: This replaces the community's whole state. If it stops being closed, everything already written in it becomes public. Only the owner changes access.
notas.comunidade-posse: An ownership change can't be undone. Whoever receives it becomes the owner, and you become a moderator, if there is room.
notas.comunidade-posse-encerrar: Closing can't be undone. The community disappears from every read and from search, and its content leaves storage after 30 days.
notas.topico: The topic starts a conversation in the community. A poll, if any, can't change once created and a vote can't be taken back.
notas.topico-editar: Editing works up to 30 minutes after the topic and at most 5 times. Readers see an "edited" mark and can read earlier versions.
notas.resposta-forum: The reply joins the conversation thread. Forum replies can't be edited: to change one, delete it and write again.
notas.pagina-criar: The page becomes public, with the name you approve here. You become its owner and manage who else posts on it.
notas.pagina-atualizar: This changes the page's name, description and theme, for everyone who follows it.
notas.pagina-publicar: The update shows in the timeline of everyone who follows the page.
notas.apelacao: Who decides: the community owner, if a moderator acted; the network administration, if the owner did. The protocol doesn't guarantee a response time.
notas.conversa-pedir: The request travels in clear: the other person reads it and decides whether to accept, and the relay operator can also read it until the decision. Only friends receive requests.
notas.mensagem: The message leaves encrypted: only your rover and the one on the other side read it. The relay sees that you talk and when, not the text.

publicado.recado: {nome}'s message is on the wall. You can delete it whenever you like.
publicado.depoimento: {nome}'s testimonial was sent. It only shows once its owner accepts.
publicado.comunidade-criar: {nome} opened the community. It is live.
publicado.comunidade-atualizar: The community change is in effect.
publicado.topico: {nome}'s topic is open in the community.
publicado.topico-editar: The topic edit is in effect.
publicado.pagina-criar: {nome} opened the page. It is live.
publicado.pagina-atualizar: The page change is in effect.
publicado.pagina-publicar: {nome}'s update went out on the page.
publicado.apelacao: {nome}'s appeal was sent. Whoever decides will read it.
publicado.conversa-pedir: {nome}'s request was sent. The conversation opens when the other side accepts.

socAprovar.releRecusou: The relay didn't accept it now: {motivo} The draft is still here, untouched.
socAprovar.textoMudou: The text changed. Read it again before approving.
